transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-01-30 | Start 10:00am PT | Duration: ~60 minutes
Organizer: Sofia Patel (CEO)
Attendees: Sofia Patel, Marco Diaz, Leah Chen, Arjun Reddy, Emily Carter, Ravi Malhotra + ~120 on webinar

Summary:
Sofia opens with brief company health update: revenue growth, ARR guidance for Q1, headcount plan; Marco and Leah present product and infra highlights (Redwood API improvements, Dedicated rollout, Private onboarding), Ravi covers infra benchmarks and cost work; Emily covers hiring and people ops; Q&A at the end.

Transcript:
[00:00] Sofia: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, happy new year, uh we'll get started. I wanna kick off with a quick look back at Q4 and then forward into Q1 priorities. We have the recording and slides linked in the all-hands channel.
[00:18] Sofia: Quick numbers — bookings were up about 28% q/q, usage growth is strong, dedicated pipeline moved faster than we expected which is great. We are raising ARR guidance a little for Q1 but we still need to be conservative on margin.
[00:35] Marco: Hi all, Marco here. On the product infra side, we've shipped two major items: streaming improvements for the Redwood API which reduce tail latency, and the new autoscaling policy for Dedicated. There's a lot of detail in the notes.
[00:50] Marco: The streaming changes are mostly around continuous batching and better kernel selection on GPUs, that reduced median latency by ~12% in our internal perf tests. There were some transcription artifacts in the last test where the K V cache was mis-logged, so ignore that earlier note.
[01:12] Leah: On the runtime side we've been focused on reliability work — rolling restarts, better KV cache eviction, and more graceful fallback to smaller model variants when memory spikes. That reduced incidents by two-thirds month over month.
[01:30] Leah: Also note, the Private onboarding flow is in beta with two customers — one in finance and one in healthcare — both doing initial compliance checks. Some names got garbled in notes, but it's the same teams we mentioned in December.
[01:48] Ravi: Quick infra update: for Dedicated we've run larger benchmarks on A100 and H100 nodes; H100 gives better perf per dollar for certain sequence lengths but depends on quantization profile. The spreadsheet's in the infra channel. We saw batch size of 8 with kv prefetching gave the best throughput for our gen workloads.
[02:10] Ravi: There's still work to do on instance packing and burst policies, and we need to tune cold start behaviour for private deployments. We will share a timeline and benchmark CSV next week.
[02:28] Arjun: Product updates — a few highlights: 1) easier model pinning in the console; 2) rollout controls for canary/AB/auto-fallback; 3) a small evals UI for quality regression tracking. We're pushing a docs update and examples for PLG customers.
[02:50] Arjun: Pricing for Private is being finalized — we want simple tiers but flexible enterprise add-ons for observability and longer log retention. Leah and I will sync on the pricing draft later this week.
[03:05] Emily: People update — hiring plan: we are still on track to add ~30 engineers this quarter, with priority on infra, runtime, and security. Manager training is scheduled for Feb 3, please RSVP. Also shout-outs to the eng guild for shipping the stream changes.
[03:25] Sofia: A quick note on compliance: SOC 2 readiness is progressing, vendor assessments are mostly done, we expect the audit window in Q2. Security docs will be posted to the customer security page; SEs will get the pack to share with customers.
[03:45] Attendee (Q): Hi — curious about Dedicated SLA and latency guarantees, will that be part of the initial launch?
[03:55] Marco: Great question — initial Dedicated has throughput & uptime SLAs, latency SLOs will be documented but we will offer stronger latency guarantees in premium tiers. There will be regional placement for latency sensitive customers.
[04:14] Attendee (Q): Any update on caching/embedding cost optimization?
[04:20] Leah: We're rolling out better prefix caching and an optimizer that suggests batching and cache settings per workload — you'll see a new tab in the console that recommends settings. It's not perfect yet — sometimes the optimizer suggests overly aggressive caching which hurts freshness, so we have guardrails.
[04:45] Marco: Also, note competitor landscape: a few customers asked about multi-cloud options vs vendor lock, we continue to emphasize portability and the ability to run Private in customer's VPC or on-prem.
[05:05] Sofia: Hiring and org notes — small change in product leadership: Arjun will take on Head of Product role for serving, and we'll hire a Principal PM to cover developer experience. Please give Arjun a congrats in Slack.
[05:25] Emily: Culture update — Valentine's day charity match and town hall for new hires next week. Also reminder: managers please complete performance calibration by Feb 15.
[05:40] Sofia: OK we'll open for questions — please use the raise hand or chat so we can triage.
[06:00] Speaker 6: Hi, quick technical question for infra — what are the fallback models we plan to enable when memory pressure spikes?
[06:10] Marco: We're maintaining a compatibility matrix; fallback will prefer quantized variants where possible and then narrower context variants — it's in the rollout doc. There are some edge cases with older model families where KV layout differs, so SEs will get a compatibility table.
[06:35] Speaker 7: On Private deploys — do we support HSM/KMS integrations out of the box?
[06:44] Ravi: Yes, we support customer-managed KMS in the VPC package; HSM is an enterprise add-on and requires a short integration project, we'll provide templates.
[07:05] Speaker 8: Ops question — are we still planning to increase observability retention? Customers asked for 90 days.
[07:12] Leah: We're offering retention add-ons as a paid option; base retention will remain 30 days, add-on for 90/365 days available. We need to finalize pricing.
[07:35] Sofia: Anything else? If not, quick recap of next steps.
[07:45] Sofia: Recap: teams push Q1 OKRs by Feb 6, infra share Dedicated benchmarks by Feb 13, product finalize Private pricing by Feb 10, people run manager training on Feb 3. We'll post slides and recording.
[08:05] Sofia: Thanks everyone, and again congrats on the releases at year-end, very proud of the work.

Notes about transcript quality: automated captions had occasional mis-hearings, proper nouns sometimes garbled, punctuation minimal. Links referenced: slides link (internal), infra benchmark spreadsheet (internal), SOC2 tracker (internal).
